entities.summary: Kim Moon-soo is a South Korean politician and former labor activist who served as the minister of employment and labor from 2024 to 2025. A member of the People Power Party, he was the party's nominee in the 2025 presidential election, losing by nearly 8.5 points to DPK nominee Lee Jae Myung.
